messages:
Noah: Drafting a tiny 'micro-commitment' pattern for OKRs and self-reviews 15s pasteables so folks can write evidence-first lines quickly. Trying to keep each item to one headline + one evidence line. Feedback?

Priya: Love the idea. Can you show one for PM roadmap work and one for an IC engineer?

Noah: Yep. Added two examples + a short manager coaching prompt pack. Also included a 'confidence band' field managers can add to help calibration.

Elena: Quick thought: add an 'evidence snapshot' note (1 metric or 1 artifact link) so reviewers can validate quickly.

Ravi: Can we include a 1-line template for "blocked / needs" so leads can see risks in reviews?

people-ops-bot: Saved to templates library: /templates/self-review/micro-commitments  public

Noah: Pasteables (copyable into self-review or manager notes):
- Micro-OKR headline (PM): "Ship prioritized search-relevance experiment (Q) to increase relevant CTR +8%"
  - Evidence snapshot: "A/B 2wk: treatment CTR +8% (p<.05); experiment funnel dashboard: /dash/exp123"
  - Confidence band (optional): "High confidence if we can unblock data infra by week 2"

- Micro-OKR headline (IC Eng): "Cut feature Z p95 latency from 420ms to <=300ms"
  - Evidence snapshot: "Bench tests + canary at 25% show median 270ms; perf harness: github.com/org/perf/rez"
  - Blocker line (1L): "Need infra quota bump for perf workers; asking for 0.2 FTE support"

- Self-review 2-line (IC): "Committed to improving uploads pipeline reliability; reduced failures from 4% to 0.9% by adding retries and backoff. Artifact: PR #432 and monitoring alert linked."

- Manager note (1 line): "Supports team OKR on availability; recommended to mark as 'high-impact' in calibration if stability shows <=1% failure for two weeks."

- Calibration confidence shorthand (picker): "High / Medium / Low + quick rationale (one sentence). Example: 'Medium 1d: dependent on infra quota approval.'"

Ravi: These are really tight and actionable. Can we add a pasteable coaching prompt set for 1:1s?

Noah: Sure 1-line coach prompts:
- "What's the smallest experiment to validate this by week 2?"
- "What specific support do you need from me or infra this sprint?"
- "If this doesn't move, what's the fallback goal we can commit to?"

Priya: Can people-ops send this as a short pinned note and maybe a single-slide cheat for leads? :sparkles:

people-ops-bot: Done  pinned in #people-ops and slide added to /slides/one-pagers/okrs-microcommit.pdf

Elena: I'll try this in my self-review tonight and tag the artifact links. Thanks!

Noah: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll copy this into the manager templates and schedule a 10-min demo in the leads sync.
